advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Worthy Advisary: Cam Skattebo + Malik Willis for Parker Washington.

reasons: You're 10-4 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 21%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 27% of the time with the first-round bye and 17% without it. You get the bye in 36% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (172.6 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 21%, 22%, 17%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 21% to 24%, and your lineup comes out 2.8 points a week ahead overall. Cam Skattebo + Malik Willis add 4.2 points a week for you today, but Parker Washington is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,359, get 4,082), and it helps their lineup too (+4.5 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 22% and 17% to 25% and 22%.
You have 6 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Amon-Ra St. Brown is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (8.1 points a week).
Cam Skattebo may be worth more now than later: value 2,366 vs ~1,668 for 6.4 pts/wk of production.
D'Andre Swift's trade value has dropped 31% in 8 days.
Jordan Love's trade value has dropped 17% in 8 days.
Chase Brown's trade value has dropped 37% in 8 days.
